family_adjudication: Adopt reviewer mechanism groups conservatively for this exact packet. Shared broad mechanisms need not be near-identical templates; groups do not establish independent statistical units.

relationship_analysis.assessment: Closest genuine template-level overlap: sum category counts times category values. Surface domain and number of categories differ, but the computational skeleton is the same. Treat these as a potential near-duplicate dependency for split design, although the exact texts are not near-identical.
Same weighted-count-total family. G04 adds a complete-week repetition factor; this is an extra step, so it is not an exact template clone, but independence should not be assumed.

Shared component-wise percentage-adjusted cost aggregation. G06 and G10 share surcharge-plus-other-cost structure; G06 adds subset counting and several gifts, G10 first combines the insurance base. G01 uses two discounts and a credit. Potential family dependence, not a claim of near-identical questions.

Cross-family arithmetic overlap: B07 also aggregates multiplicities but does not apply per-unit values or a time repetition factor. Shared addition skill alone is not evidence of near-identical template dependence.
Cross-family percentage skill. G09 is successive changes to a running amount; others apply percentages to distinct named cost components. Same broad skill does not make the templates identical.

All involve order or position at a broad level. Constraint deduction, static positional filtering, dynamic swaps, and lexicographic sorting are materially different mechanisms; no near-identical template dependence found among these.
